Last updated: October 1, 2026

These terms govern your use of houstonpowerwashingpro.com and the phone line published on it, (832) 662-4107. Houston Power Washing Pro is a d/b/a of Dominion Digital Group. Please read these terms before you call or send a request.

What this service is

Houston Power Washing Pro is a referral service. When you call, an automated assistant answers and connects you with an independent, locally owned pressure washing company serving your area. Houston Power Washing Pro does not perform pressure washing or any exterior cleaning, and it does not send employees or crews to your property.

Your agreement is with the company you hire

The company you are connected with is an independent business. It sets its own prices, inspects the job, gives you any estimate, schedules the work, performs it and is responsible for it. Any warranty, guarantee, payment terms or cancellation policy is between you and that company and should be given to you in writing. Houston Power Washing Pro is not a party to that agreement and does not quote, schedule, supervise or guarantee the work.

No charge to you

There is no charge for calling or for being connected. The companies the line connects callers with may pay Houston Power Washing Pro a referral fee.

Insurance and credentials

Ask any company for proof of liability insurance and a written price before work begins, and confirm any credentials you rely on. Houston Power Washing Pro does not verify or vouch for any company's licenses, permits or insurance.

Information you give

When you call, the details you provide, such as your name, phone number, location and the work you need, are passed to the company handling your request so it can contact you. See the Privacy Policy.

Website content

Information on this website is general guidance. It is not a quote, a guarantee of availability, or professional advice about your property. Any published price ranges are third-party figures shown for general context; prices, timelines and rules change over time, and the company you hire sets its own.

Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent allowed by law, Houston Power Washing Pro and Dominion Digital Group are not liable for the work, products, pricing or conduct of any independent company you choose to hire, or for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of this website or the phone line.

Emergencies

If anyone's safety is at risk, such as a gas smell, fire, electrical hazard or heat illness, call 911 first.

Changes

These terms may be updated from time to time. The date at the top shows the latest version.
